scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: eslint . && cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run python -m techinterview.db.client
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m techinterview.db.seed
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python -m techinterview.db.seed
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn techinterview.main:app --reload --reload-dir src --port 8787
scripts.test:collaboration: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/collaboration
